statement.zh-TW: 能站在股東與債權人的立場，說出同一個經營決定各自在意的報表數字與風險
statement.en: Take the position of a shareholder and of a creditor and say which figures on the statements and which risks each cares about in the same business decision

text.zh-TW: 以為所有利害關係人都只看本期淨利
text.en: Thinking every stakeholder looks only at profit for the period

text.zh-TW: 以為債權人和股東一樣希望公司多冒險追求成長
text.en: Thinking creditors, like shareholders, want the company to take more risk for growth

statement.zh-TW: 能站在員工與客戶的立場，說出他們從財報中關心的穩定性與持續經營的訊號
statement.en: Take the position of an employee and of a customer and say which signals of stability and going concern they look for in the statements

text.zh-TW: 以為員工只需要關心薪資費用那一列
text.en: Thinking employees need only look at the wages line

text.zh-TW: 以為客戶不需要看供應商的財報
text.en: Thinking a customer has no reason to read a supplier’s statements

statement.zh-TW: 能在利益衝突的情境中，說明一個決定對不同利害關係人的得失，並說出自己的取捨依據
statement.en: In a situation of conflicting interests, explain what each stakeholder gains and loses from a decision and state the basis of your own trade-off

text.zh-TW: 以為一定找得到讓所有利害關係人都滿意的方案
text.en: Thinking there is always an option that satisfies every stakeholder

text.zh-TW: 以為利益衝突只能靠誰人多、誰出錢多來決定
text.en: Thinking conflicts can only be settled by headcount or by who paid the most
